findings.explanation: Saber specifically misclassifies date as an abbreviation; the English broadens this to any specialist vocabulary and weakens the joke.

findings.evidenceJa: 別に専門的な単語じゃないぞ
findings.governingReading: It is not a technical term.
findings.explanation: Vocabulary is incorrectly treated as a singular count noun, leaving malformed English at the punch line.

findings.evidenceJa: ますます不思議そうに顔をしかめた
findings.governingReading: Her frown grows still more puzzled.
findings.explanation: Saber’s bafflement is recast as displeasure, distorting the emotional beat of her realization that Shirou sees her as a girl.
Saber’s deliberate regulating breath becomes a sigh, adding weariness or resignation.

findings.highlight: it would be strange for you to be out walking
findings.evidenceJa: おいそれと出歩く方がおかしい
findings.governingReading: It would be strange for a Master to go wandering about so readily or casually.
findings.explanation: The restriction is broadened from careless everyday roaming to being outside at all.

findings.evidenceJa: 流れていく景色を挑むように見つめている
findings.governingReading: She stares at the passing scenery as if challenging it.
findings.explanation: The English removes Saber’s combative gaze, flattening the comic sign of how tense she is about the date.
Shirou’s covert attention and embarrassment disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: あり得る筈のない非日常が混入している
findings.governingReading: An impossible piece of the extraordinary has intruded into his everyday life.
findings.explanation: A violation of the boundary between ordinary life and the impossible is reduced to the presence of something unusual.

findings.evidenceJa: 本格的に、手のつけられないぐらい緊張してきた
findings.governingReading: He is becoming seriously nervous, to a degree he cannot control.
findings.explanation: The translation omits that his nerves are getting beyond his ability to manage them.

findings.highlight: Her hair is like golden silk
findings.governingReading: hair like gold dust or golden sand
findings.explanation: The granular glittering image is replaced with smooth silk.

findings.highlight: I was finally able to believe in Saber with everything I have
findings.evidenceJa: 後戻りできないところまでセイバーを信じるようになって
findings.governingReading: He has come to trust Saber past the point where he can turn back.
findings.explanation: Irreversible emotional commitment becomes a completed ability to believe with maximum effort.
